title: Steve Cartisano
excerpt: Editorial research draft about Steve Cartisano (about 1956-2019), founder of the Challenger Foundation, where Kristen Chase died in 1990, who kept opening programs in Hawaii, Samoa and Canada after Utah barred him. He was acquitted of all charges in 1992.

meta.person_role: Founder of the Challenger Foundation; later director of programs in Samoa

person_notable_work: Ran the forced-march program where Kristen Chase, 16, died of heatstroke in 1990
Moved operations offshore after Utah barred him from running survival programs
